scope: Staging-only manual QA of VSN theme app blocks in the unpublished Horizon theme. No app deployment, theme publication, or Live/production action.

checks.evidence: Added Single field to the Horizon Default product template, set Resource=Product and namespace/key to vsn_theme_smoke_20261009.material, saved, reloaded the theme editor, and confirmed the saved settings remained.
After save and again after editor reload, the unpublished Horizon product preview rendered the label 'Details' and exact value 'Staging theme smoke: stainless steel, 500 g'.
The same Horizon product preview rendered the Specifications block with Material and the exact public value.
Earlier inspection of debut-vintage-theme showed its legacy product template without an app-block insertion point. It was not modified or published.

limitations: Only one unpublished theme was verified for actual public-value rendering; two-theme acceptance remains open.
Specifications ordering, multiple instances, and full setting usability were not exhaustively tested.
Mobile-preview mode was opened, but this pass does not certify responsive/accessibility acceptance.
This evidence is manual UI verification; automated checks and Cloudflare request-log review are separate.
No screenshot artifact was retained in the repository.
No live deployment, theme publication, production data change, or app release was performed.
